study.scope: Longer-budget specialization on twelve already exposed length-5 conditions. Conservative settings are an experimental package, not a safety guarantee or fresh generalization claim.

ppo.network: Separate two-layer 64x64 tanh actor/value networks; categorical 3-action output
ppo.normalization: Advantage normalization only; fixed sensor scaling; no VecNormalize.
ppo.transfer: Weights-only copy; six64-decision updates during384 then frozen256. Per-arm learning rate and PPO clip override base before model construction. Constant schedules, no KL early stop.

policy_input.initialization: 11 zero absent frames plus current local frame; invalid sensor values zero under validity masks.
policy_input.critic: Same local stack as actor; no privileged critic inputs.

action_rng.rule: base + source_seed*1000 + ordered case index, matching October7. Seed once after fresh construction and weights-only copy; no reseed at384. Torch categorical, use_sde=False; optimizer updates leave Torch RNG unchanged.

study.initialization: Fresh optimizer, buffer, counters, world and empty history per opportunity. Frozen/conservative/standard copy exact pooled actor+critic; scratch copies saved pre-source initial tensors. No source optimizer state.
study.continuity: One world/history/RNG for640: learn384 then frozen256 from model._last_obs. No reset, set_env, rescue, second learn or action reseed. Weights and optimizer fixed after384.

gates.comparison: integrated native return over the whole640 opportunity, including384 learning decisions
gates.combined_readiness: For each declared method separately: useful-benefit AND target reliability AND sampled retention AND probe reliability. Do not select the better arm afterward. No automatic promotion even if passed.

study.guard_rule: After all144 target attempts and refs are sealed: six original frozen baselines then144 frozen probes of72 conservative/standard after384 checkpoints on the same two fixed old conditions. Missing384 checkpoints produce blocked zero-exposure receipts, no retry. This tests two sampled conditions only.
study.failure_rule: Record raw stopped prefixes and incomplete/faulted attempts; never rescue, retry, impute a completed return, remove cases, or select a winning arm/seed/checkpoint. Invalid source/lock globally blocks new worlds. Each benefit contrast and sampled retention eligibility are reported separately.
study.promotion: None. Adapted checkpoints are local experiment evidence; immutable pretrained base and live workshop stay unchanged. Original rover-v3 challenge remains unexposed.
study.repeatability: Same action RNG as October7. Repeated frozen640 and standard prefix128 are integrity checks on exposed cases, not new independent evidence. Compare native/actions and initial/64/128 policy and Adam tensors against bound earlier trials.
